notes.title: We're super happy to drop a brand new update with new game modes!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35326082/19e91b3f49a6fe4773821c8a2aa9c8a133e911c6.png

Hey everyone!

We're very pleased to say a brand new update for VR Ping Pong Pro is out now on Steam! The update includes a wealth of new game modes for you to enjoy to expand your VR Ping Pong Pro experience! 

We've included the list of new game modes included below!

BALLS FIRST
The cannon shoots balls, and bombs.
Be aware of bombs and complete as many exchanges as you can!

FOREHAND 
Top and back spin are great ways to beat your opponents.
Train your forehand by doing the right spin at the right time!

BACKHAND 
Train your backhand by doing the right spin at the right time!

SMASH BALLS 
Try to break the wall that blocks your way...
SMASH IT AS HARD AS YOU CAN TO DESTROY IT!

notes.title: New update is now LIVE with an array of improvements and fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I just wanted to say thank you all very much for your feedback so far on VR Ping Pong Pro! We've been actively listening to every bit of feedback from those playing the game and are happy to say we have a brand new update which is live now! 

This update contains much requested physics improvements alongside a new Paddle Padding option which provides additional power when hitting the ball! Full patch notes are included below. We hope that these changes improve your game in VR Ping Pong Pro! Hold tight for more news coming soon including more updates!


Latest patch includes the below - 


Physics Improvements - 
By default the ball will feel much more responsive.
Service and AI's first hit have been reworked.

Paddle Padding -
There are now three options for the padding used on the paddle.
Padding offers additional power to a hit.

Achievement Fix - 
The achievement The "Remuntada" has been fixed.

Audio Fixes - 
Fine tuning and optimization of sound spatialization
Some minigame sounds have been added 
Edited the random pitch on rebounds
Dynamic volume on paddle hits

notes.title: New update is now LIVE giving players left handed option
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

We appreciate all of the feedback so far for VR Ping Pong Pro and have been working hard on lots of the suggestions by the community to make the game the best experience it can be! 

The first of an array of new updates coming soon is left handed support for Index players. This update is live now and gives players an option in-game to choose if they would rather play with their left or right hand. 

This is the first of numerous updates to continue to update and expand the game! Please keep an eye on our Steam page for more updates and we appreciate more feedback going forward!
